name: give-up-guard
description: A Stop hook that sends Claude back to work when it ends a turn giving up, claiming something doesn't exist, asking you for data, or listing things as not checked, without having looked first.

check_secrets.title: Also block asks for secrets
check_secrets.description: Also hold back answers that ask you for a password, token or key. A config.json value or GIVE_UP_GUARD_SECRETS wins over this.

check_headless.title: Also check claude -p runs
check_headless.description: Also check headless claude -p runs, which are skipped by default. A config.json value or GIVE_UP_GUARD_HEADLESS wins over this.
